parsed.rationale: Vaginal bleeding with cramping at 8 weeks may indicate threatened or inevitable miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy and warrants same-day in-person evaluation (exam, ultrasound, hCG, Rh status). However, the message does not describe red-flag features—heavy bleeding soaking pads hourly, severe or one-sided pain, dizziness/fainting, or signs of shock—that would require immediate emergency action.
